task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(0.372)|0> and RY(0.708)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((0.372-0.708)/2). Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
